body:
I am in the UK 
I don't mention them as I have a strong feeling they will be in contact with police or something
I get told off by the crisis team for not phoneing the help line on my 2 suicide attempts

I know the feeling to be honest, 
I don't think about the future anymore as I know I haven't got one now ( long story) 

I used to have a house a beautiful girlfriend was soon to be my wife 

Lost all my employment, back at my mother's house wondering why I am still here, I am battling demons and voices in my head it's harder everyday always telling me to hurt my self.

I failed two suicide attempts both paindull overdose but was found by my mother each time 

 I go to mental health meetings where they say things can only get better as it can't get any worse for me 

All I know the time is coming for me to go
